facts.fact: Sidwaya reports that the ALP voted on 3 August 2026 the bill on protection of natural persons with regard to personal data processing; no promulgation is stated.
facts.system: Projet de loi relatif a la protection des personnes physiques a l'egard du traitement des donnees a caractere personnel

facts.fact: Sidwaya reports the ALP also voted on 3 August 2026 the bill organising the regulator ARCOD, merging the CSC and the CIL, which takes over supervision of personal data processing.
facts.system: Projet de loi relatif a la protection des personnes physiques a l'egard du traitement des donnees a caractere personnel

facts.fact: Sidwaya reports the ALP voted a new data protection bill on 3 August 2026, with fines indexed to turnover excluding tax and a ban on transferring sensitive data abroad.
facts.system: Projet de loi relatif a la protection des personnes physiques a l'egard du traitement des donnees a caractere personnel
